title: Monotonicity of memory agreement
statement: Let $K,K':\mathbb{N}\to\mathrm{Prop}$ and let $\mu,\mu':\mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{Z}$. If $\mu$ and $\mu'$ agree at every index satisfying $K$, and every index satisfying $K'$ also satisfies $K$, then $\mu$ and $\mu'$ agree at every index satisfying $K'$.
